limitations: saved-fit elapsed is the sum over retained completed fits, not CPU time or full hardware cost; failed partial work/refits/I/O/idle time excluded
cell receipt elapsed/cache hits cover only its successful last attempt
wall time starts at earliest recorded supervisor invocation; quarantined005 cost excluded
sign tolerance 1e-12 is the existing recomputation tolerance, not practical equivalence
changed-only counts describe observed mismatches, not a selected-policy performance estimand
all paired endpoints are reported; no grid retuning or superiority test
